multiplicity: Holm correction across the three primary cost contrasts

interval.interpretation: descriptive; eight seed pairs do not establish precise interval coverage

included_outcomes: All completed executions, including retries and fallbacks; no outcome-based exclusion
incomplete_policy: Report missing or interrupted executions; do not run confirmatory contrasts until all 32 planned executions are complete
stopping_rule: Exactly eight predetermined seeds; do not extend, replace seeds, tune, or stop because significance was or was not obtained
budget_stop_policy: A budget stop yields an explicitly incomplete pilot; it does not change the registered sample or permit selective inference
interpretation: Exploratory pilot, not a full factorial experiment. It cannot identify all C, M, T or interaction effects. Sign-flip inference assumes paired differences are sign-exchangeable under the null.
reporting: Report all conditions, all three planned contrasts, effect sizes, intervals, raw and adjusted p-values, and null or unfavorable outcomes
